It is the name of a marsh near the Isthmus of Corinth, formerly called Ἐσχατιῶτις [Eschatiotis], later Γοργῶπις [Gorgopis] because Γόργην [Gorge] fell into it (the marsh). See Etym. M. p. 384, 32 and Hesychius s.v. Γοργώπις [Gorgopis].
